content: Residents of a town say a "total lack of care and maintenance" of a pond caused scores of fish to be washed up dead in the water.
According to conservationists, fish deaths have resulted from low water flows and high levels of pollutants like ammonia and nitrates, which are primarily sourced from agriculture and sewage.
